Welcome to Home Fixers and Decor Team, your trusted local source for premier handyman and interior decor services within the San Antonio area and its neighboring regions.

Our dedicated team takes pride in being locally owned and deeply committed to delivering unparalleled assistance for your residential and commercial needs. From preparing make-ready apartments for occupancy to enhancing Airbnb spaces, we offer an extensive range of services tailored to your requirem

Whether the task entails rectifying issues with your kitchen sink, assembling Ikea furniture, revitalizing kitchen cabinets, tending to air conditioning or swimming pool repairs, or undertaking intricate interior decor projects, our capabilities are comprehensive. Simply put, we're equipped to handl

Enlist the expertise of our adept handyman crew and decor team to craft purposeful environments that cater to your demands. Whether it's your home, office, apartment complex, or Airbnb, we're poised to transform spaces into aesthetically captivating and functionally optimal realms.
Our operational hours span from Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM, providing you with flexible accessibility.
Rest assured that even during emergencies, we're here to assist. Should you require emergency service, kindly leave a message, and we will promptly respond to your needs.

Highest Quality Service For us, our customers are our top priority. We provide you with comfort and peace of mind knowing that your home or business is being well cared for by our team of professionals.
